en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play catch
Let's run a marathon
Let's play word chain
Yes, let's do that.

At the laboratory, the professor would play
catch with me all the time.

Professor Idabashi had a pretty good arm,
actually.

My throw speed is approximate to that of
a strong senior citizen...

But the professor can throw a ball way
faster than I can!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm having trouble determining
if that's good or bad...
Definitely!

Except...that sort of intense exercise makes
me worry about my back...

I'm very grateful to the professor for
giving me many human qualities...

But I don't think he needed to recreate
back pain, do you...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I have no way of knowing what's
going on with your body, Keebo.

Wha—! You're underestimating me, aren't
you!?

I have the intelligence of an average high
school student, just like the rest of you!

Such games are better suited for an infant
AI that has just begun to learn words!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
